Bug_Title: STI: Unneeded use of currentThread() call, to call interrupted() (STI_INTERRUPTED_ON_CURRENTTHREAD)
Bug_Details:
This method invokes the Thread.currentThread() call, just to call the
interrupted() method. As interrupted() is a static method, it is more
simple and clear to use Thread.interrupted().
 Thread.currentThread() interrupted() interrupted() Thread.interrupted()
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the showBug() method where the unnecessary use of Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() is causing the issue. This call can be replaced with Thread.interrupted() for simplicity and clarity.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug() method which uses the Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() call, which is an unneeded use of the current thread. The test case expects the method to return true when the thread is interrupted, but it will not because of the bug.
